name: Naeba Akira
source:
Student of class 2-C, member of the Volunteer Department. An exceptional guy with great grades and a professional in athletic activities. He doesn't have a purpose just as an average student and member, but he will stand up to protect his club from his sister as a result of her twisted proposition to endanger school clubs.

He is unable to use magic, but he is a skilled battler. But he appears to have the power to strip bras and undergarments from other people with the snap of his fingers.

He plays the role of hit and run in the team.
